verdict.line: You lose if Kled lands Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) and strings W (Violent Tendencies) autos before you react; you win every trade where you blind him first or he's forced to burn E (Jousting) for nothing.

brief.thesis: Kled's whole kit is built to close distance and land four empowered autos from W (Violent Tendencies), and Teemo has zero hard peel to stop that once it starts. The matchup still sits at 50% over 60 games because Blinding Dart completely voids an auto-attack-based burst combo, and Toxic Shot poison punishes every approach Kled makes for free. The lane is close because both champions are answering the same question — who gets their cooldown off first.

theirWindow.when: Kled lands Q hook or closes with E
theirWindow.what: Once the yank or dash connects he'll chain into W (Violent Tendencies) for four empowered autos, the 4th hitting hardest. If you're already in range when this starts you're losing the trade — back off before he commits, not after.

yourWindow.when: Kled's E (Jousting) or Q is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Both his engage tools sit at 13/12/11/10/9s and 11/10/9/8/7s. The moment either whiffs or gets used to reposition, he has no gap-closer for several seconds — walk up and free-hit with Toxic Shot autos, no risk.

start.why: Taken in 82.3% of games (50.8% win over 65 games) — the mana and sustain let you spam Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot through his early Q/E poke without running dry.

boots.why: 51.3% pick rate at 55% win over 40 games — the magic pen scales your poison DOT damage through Skaarl's large health pool.

core.why: First item in the 42.9%-pick, 54.2%-win path — gives you the auto-attack speed and movement to keep landing Toxic Shot while kiting his dashes.
Second in that same build path — the burn amplifies against a high-HP target like mounted Skaarl, turning your poke into real DPS.
Caps the core path (54.2% win, 24 games) — cooldown reduction means more Blinding Darts available to void his W auto-reset windows.

situational.when: he keeps closing distance and you need more attack speed to punish every window his E is down
their team starts building magic resist shields or tankier frontline around Kled
the lane is already won and you're scaling into a pure poke/burst teamfight role

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the exact pattern this lane demands — landing consecutive Toxic Shot autos while he's forced to either tank the stacks or disengage, amplifying your damage right as he commits to a trade.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick at 87.7% (46.5% win) — Flash answers his Q yank/E dash all-in, and Ignite punishes any poke-heavy trade he walks away low from. If his aggression is overwhelming you, Exhaust+Flash is the small-sample outlier worth noting (80% win, 6.2% pick) for directly neutering his W auto burst.

playing.title: Respect his 800-range Q
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope outranges your 680-range Toxic Shot auto by 120 units. Never stand at max auto range thinking you're safe — he can hook you before you can even hit him back.

playing.title: Save Q for his W window
playing.detail: The instant he starts attacking with Violent Tendencies active, land Blinding Dart. It completely nullifies the empowered auto-attack string, including the hardest-hitting 4th hit.

playing.title: Freeze and poke, don't shove
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has no cooldown — every auto you land for free is value he can't contest without eating poison stacks. Let the wave sit near your tower so his dash-ins are longer and riskier.

playing.title: Zone jungle entrances with R
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has a 1s cooldown and only 230 range, so plant mushrooms where he walks to joust or gank from — the slow and DOT punish his E (Jousting) re-dash path.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's courage bar
playing.detail: If you can blind and kite enough of his autos, Skaarl's health drops and Kled dismounts, swapping Q for the weaker Pocket Pistol and losing damage to champions until he remounts.

playing.title: Use W to escape, not chase
playing.detail: Move Quick's speed boost is removed the moment a champion hits you, so pop it to disengage before his E lands, not after you're already tagged.

playing.title: Don't contest double-dash range
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through its target, doubling his effective engage/disengage distance. If he's already dashed in, expect the return trip — don't walk into the reset line.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the matchup, not measured data.
